services.name: Weddings & Rentals
services.desc: Paramount Theatre Events has the perfect venue for every occasion. Whether you are hosting a wedding, meeting, or fundraising event, we have the right space for you! With a team rooted in exceptional customer service, we will be with you every step of the way to ensure your event is a success. Weddings with Paramount Theatre Events are every couples’ top choice when finding “The Place to Say I Do.” Our weddings are known to combine high-end elegance with affordability and customization. For meetings, conferences, and company retreats, Paramount Theatre Events is the ideal location for your team. We host groups from 6 to 6,000 with options to rent multiple spaces for your unique event needs.

services.name: Dance Classes
services.desc: At PSA we have a wide variety of technique and stylistic focused dance classes for every student of every age. You can dip your toe into tap for the first time, or see how fast you can pick up choreography in our speed choreography class - there truly is something for everyone. At PSA we meet each artist where they are and offer modifications to fit each individual dancer’s needs on their journey. Students have access to two of the largest and most gorgeous dance spaces in our area, equipped with floor-to-ceiling mirrors, sprung natural oak hardwood floors (perfect for tapping), incredible sound systems, and fun lighting to set the mood for any style.
